messages:
maggie: noticed EU-WEST3 GPU attaches failing. kube logs: 'attach held: disk iops exceeded threshold'.

maggie: quick check on node: nvme %util ~100 during model prewarm window. iostat snapshot attached inline.

raj: did we bump prewarm concurrency recently?

sam: yes, last week prewarm replicas increased to 6 to cut cold starts.

maggie: correlation looks strong 1: attach failure rate jumped after rollout.

izzy: short fixes: scale prewarm back to 2, set PREWARM_PARALLELISM=1, avoid warmups during janitor scrub (02:00-04:00 UTC).

maggie: scaling now.

ops-bot: deploy triggered: maggie:reduce-prewarm -> rollout started (canary 20%).

raj: medium term: prototype per-node token-bucket for warmup pulls or cgroups blkio to prevent starving system IO.

sam: also run cost calc: more reserved GPU for hot models vs attach-failure churn. I'll run numbers.

izzy: add alert: nvme_util>85% && gpu_attach_errors>1/min. dashboard tile for prewarm concurrency per node.

maggie: canary looks good so far, attach errors down from ~4% to ~0.8% in eu-west3.

action items: ["raj: PoC token-bucket sidecar", "izzy: scheduler rule for scrub window", "sam: reserved pool cost analysis", "maggie: add alert/dashboard and file incident note"]
